candidates.gemini_approval_reason: Massive divergence between toxic trend regimes and highly profitable neutral regime; clear single-axis entry filter.
candidates.gemini_falsification_test: Backtest S03 with trend regime exclusion; falsified if net R in neutral regime degrades or if trade retention drops below 40% overall.
candidates.gemini_single_axis_change: Restrict entries to neutral regimes only

candidates.gemini_approval_reason: Strong OOS filter screen performance for short regime exclusion combined with clear profit-decay cluster.
candidates.gemini_falsification_test: Verify OOS performance across 1m_w1, 1m_w2, and 1m_w3 windows when short regime trades are excluded.
candidates.gemini_single_axis_change: Enforce strict regime-based exclusion filters, specifically disabling trades in short regimes.

candidates.gemini_approval_reason: High MFE relative to MAE with substantial favorable-then-loss decay; single-axis trailing stop cleanly targets exit efficiency.
candidates.gemini_falsification_test: Run historical simulation with trailing stop activated at 0.50R MFE trailing by 0.25R and verify net R improvement across all windows.
candidates.gemini_single_axis_change: Implement a trailing stop-loss activation once trade MFE crosses +0.50R.

candidates.gemini_approval_reason: Solid average MFE with concrete favorable-then-loss cluster; single-axis trailing stop addresses profit protection.

candidates.gemini_single_axis_change: Implement a trailing stop-loss activation once trade MFE crosses +0.50R to protect open equity from favorable-then-loss decay.
